query:
INSERT INTO media_storefronts (
                media_id,
                storefront_id,
                external_id,
                playtime_minutes,
                last_played_at,
                is_installed
            )
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            RETURNING
                media_id,
                storefront_id,
                external_id,
                playtime_minutes,
                last_played_at,
                is_installed AS "is_installed: bool",
                created_at,
                updated_at
